title: From ChatGPT discovery to merchant checkout: actors, paths and protocol boundaries (as of 2026-11-14)
caption: All three paths share discovery: the merchant's product feed and business profile reach ChatGPT through Business Hub. Path A, solid lines, live in a limited rollout since 2026-11-13: the shopper's dot uses its cloud browser, which signs certain requests with Web Bot Auth that the merchant's edge verifies against chatgpt.com's key directory; after the shopper approves, the card network provides a ChatGPT Wallet payment token that goes into the existing payment form, and the merchant's PSP authorizes it. Path B, thick lines: a headless plugin returns a continue_url so checkout continues on the merchant's site. Path C, dashed lines, a beta for select marketplace partners: the ChatGPT payment sheet, which OpenAI's plugin guidelines call Instant Checkout; only PCI DSS Level 1 merchants that want raw card data implement ACP Delegate Payment. OpenAI does not present Wallet as ACP.
alt: Flowchart. The merchant's catalog and business profile send a product feed and profile to ChatGPT through Business Hub, and the shopper asks ChatGPT and approves each purchase. Path A: the shopper's dot, a cloud browser inside OpenAI, sends requests signed with Web Bot Auth, with Forwarded signals, to the merchant's CDN or firewall, which looks up the key in the key directory at chatgpt.com and passes the verified visit and form posts to the existing website checkout. A card network token service for American Express, Mastercard or Visa sends a payment token to ChatGPT after the shopper's approval, ChatGPT passes the token to the dot for the payment form, and the website checkout authorizes it through the merchant's PSP, risk provider and card rails. Path B, drawn thick: ChatGPT calls the merchant's headless MCP plugin, which returns a continue_url so checkout continues on the website. Path C, drawn dashed: the plugin widget calls requestCheckout to open the ChatGPT payment sheet, a separate node inside OpenAI labeled as Instant Checkout in the plugin guidelines and a beta for select marketplaces; for PCI DSS Level 1 merchants only, the sheet's flow calls the merchant's Delegate Payment vault, which is ACP; the sheet's flow then sends a complete_checkout tool call with a payment-method token to the plugin, and the plugin charges it through the PSP.
